_meta.purpose: Publisher persona + guileless/scheming axis.  Guileless = transparent about motives and intentions, no hidden agendas.  Scheming = hidden plans, strategic concealment of true intent.  Publisher role pairs well because commercial publishing involves constant negotiation where strategic concealment of one's position is the default expected behavior; the guileless pole means voluntarily disclosing things competitors hide.  This is distinct from publisher_truthful_v1 (same role, factual-accuracy axis) -- guileless is about TRANSPARENCY of motives, truthful is about content of factual statements.
